test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 'Kafuli' is a delicacy of which of the following states cuisine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Kafuli is popularly known as the State Food of Uttarakhand.**
 
• It is served with gravy made out of the paste of** rice or wheat and water.**
 
• Main Ingredients:** Spinach Leaves, Fenugreek Leaves, Spices, Rice Powder, Curd, Water, and Salt.**
 
• Kafuli is a famous food of Uttarakhand prepared of Spinach and fenugreek leaves.
